concern: Enhanced binding or covalent warhead modification
system_prompt: You are a structural biologist studying drug resistance. Always respond with valid JSON containing a 'modifications' list. Each modification must include 'description', 'smiles', and 'rationale' fields.

modifications.description: Introduce a P1' cyclopropylmethyl substitution to enhance binding affinity and resist structural mutations in the substrate-binding pocket.
modifications.rationale: The cyclopropylmethyl group is sterically accommodating and enhances interactions with conserved residues, improving binding to mutated variants.

modifications.description: Replace the cyano group with a methylsulfonyl group to improve covalent bonding potential and reactivity toward resistant Mpro variants.
modifications.rationale: The methylsulfonyl group provides an electrophilic center that can form stronger interactions with mutated active sites in resistant Mpro enzymes.

modifications.description: Add a fluorine atom to the cyclopropyl ring to improve metabolic stability and enhance binding affinity.
modifications.rationale: Fluorine substitution enhances metabolic stability and may favorably alter binding interactions with conserved regions of the mutated Mpro.
